title: GA4 Measurement Protocol request body (web data stream)
description: Pinned external contract for the JSON body POSTed to https://www.google-analytics.com/mp/collect?measurement_id=G-XXXX&api_secret=YYYY (EU: region1.google-analytics.com; validation: /debug/mp/collect). Sourced from Google's official GA4 MP docs (see contracts/ga4-mp.md for URLs). This is the hermetic half of the ga4_mp_conformance oracle: a built payload MUST validate against this schema AND match a golden fixture; the live /debug endpoint is the complementary check. NOTE: client_id and session_id are opaque strings by contract — the _ga cookie grammar is NOT part of Google's schema and has changed (GS1->GS2), so it is not encoded here.

client_id.description: Required. Uniquely and persistently identifies the web client instance. Any stable unique string is accepted by MP; reuse the _ga cookie's client_id for continuity with on-page GA.

user_id.description: Optional. UTF-8. Cross-platform user id. No documented max length.

timestamp_micros.description: Optional. Unix timestamp in MICROSECONDS (ms x 1000). Backdating allowed up to 72 hours.

user_properties.description: Optional. Up to 25. Each property name maps to an object with a `value`.

name.description: <=40 chars, alphanumeric+underscore, starts with a letter, not a reserved name. NOTE: an unknown/typo'd but well-formed name is ACCEPTED here and by GA4 by design — the golden fixture (not this schema) is what pins the exact expected name.
